office_does: A King County District Court judge hears misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders, and is elected by voters in the electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Lisa O'Toole is the only candidate for this position and is running as the incumbent.

candidates.summary: Incumbent King County District Court judge first elected in 2014, with prior experience as a prosecuting attorney and a private civil attorney, per her pamphlet statement.
highlights: First elected to King County District Court in 2014 [S1]
Reports 30+ years practicing law as a former prosecutor and a private civil attorney [S1]
Lists endorsements from judges, local officials, and King County Democrats [S1]
